title: Finding and Recovering Work
description: Practice finding and recovering work through a concrete team scenario.

blocks.content: A commit from yesterday introduced a bug. You need to find the safe recovery tool for published history. What is the smallest Git action that keeps the work safe?

The reflog records where your local references recently pointed. It can help find a lost local commit; use `git revert` instead when undoing a shared commit.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["Working files"] -->|"choose an action"| B["Git history"] -->|"share or recover"| C["Team project"]
```

blocks.question: What can help find a lost local commit?
blocks.explanation: The reflog keeps a local record of recent reference positions.

blocks.prompt: Model the Git idea in a tiny simulator. Export a function named `recoverFile` that takes `(working, staged, file)` and returns a new staged list containing `file` once. Do not change either input list.

tests.description: works when no working files are listed yet
keeps an already staged file while adding another
